exports.name: ByRoleOptions
exports.type: unknown

members.name: busy
members.summary:
If true only includes elements in the query set that are marked as
busy in the accessibility tree, i.e., `aria-busy="true"`

members.name: checked
members.summary:
If true only includes elements in the query set that are marked as
checked in the accessibility tree, i.e., `aria-checked="true"`

members.name: current
members.summary: Filters elements by their `aria-current` state. `true` and `false` match `aria-current="true"` and `aria-current="false"` (as well as a missing `aria-current` attribute) respectively.

members.name: description
members.type: string | RegExp | ((accessibleDescription: string, element: Element) => boolean)
members.summary: Only considers elements with the specified accessible description.

members.name: expanded
members.summary:
If true only includes elements in the query set that are marked as
expanded in the accessibility tree, i.e., `aria-expanded="true"`

members.name: hidden
members.summary:
If true includes elements in the query set that are usually excluded from
the accessibility tree. `role="none"` or `role="presentation"` are included
in either case.

members.name: level
members.summary:
Includes elements with the `"heading"` role matching the indicated level,
either by the semantic HTML heading elements `<h1>-<h6>` or matching
the `aria-level` attribute.

members.name: name
members.type: string | RegExp | ((accessibleName: string, element: Element) => boolean)
members.summary: Only considers elements with the specified accessible name.

members.name: pressed
members.summary:
If true only includes elements in the query set that are marked as
pressed in the accessibility tree, i.e., `aria-pressed="true"`

members.name: queryFallbacks
members.summary:
Includes every role used in the `role` attribute
For example *ByRole('progressbar', {queryFallbacks: true})` will find <div role="meter progressbar">`.

members.name: selected
members.summary:
If true only includes elements in the query set that are marked as
selected in the accessibility tree, i.e., `aria-selected="true"`

members.name: suggest
members.summary: suppress suggestions for a specific query

members.name: value
members.type: { max?: number; min?: number; now?: number; text?: Matcher }

members.name: enableBackgroundThread
members.summary:
Render your component in the background thread or not.

Note that all user code in the top level will be executed in the background thread by default. (eg. `__BACKGROUND__` is `true` in the top level)

members.name: enableMainThread
members.summary:
Render your component in the main thread or not.

It is recommended to use this option only when you need to test the [IFR](https://lynxjs.org/zh/guide/interaction/ifr.html) behavior.
